title: Lantau in the morning, the Peak at sunset
call: Cloudy early, then mainly fine, 25 to 29°. East force 4 to 5, occasionally 6 on high ground early, which is exactly where the Ngong Ping 360 runs: it slows or stops in strong wind. Check the Observatory warnings and the cable car status on np360.com.hk at 08:00. If it is suspended or on a reduced service, switch to the backup: pool and yum cha today, Lantau on Friday. The Peak Tram is not stopped by wind, and the afternoon clears for a 17:50 sunset at the top.
src: 10%, the Hong Kong Observatory weighted highest
25° to 29°, cloudy at first, mainly fine later, east force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 on high ground at first
mm: Low risk. No rain forecast to plan around
read: Gusty early on high ground: check the cable car at 08:00. Clearing for the Peak.
tnote: Temperature shape estimated from the forecast high and low. Hourly temperatures fill in about 5 days out.
